properties.description: Coloured promo banner stacked above one real nav. On scroll-down, banner slides up and retracts leaving single clean nav; on scroll-up it slides back. Dismiss × removes banner permanently.
properties.use_case: Genuine time-bound announcement over product/marketing pages, stat-led or commerce pages
properties.anti_pattern: Making the top tier a second set of nav links ('two nav bars' smell); animating banner height directly (janky)
